title: Task
description: A unit of work. Status and claim lease fields are materialized projections of the latest status_changed and assigned events for this task. Implementations MAY keep mutable rows for read performance, but the event log is the source of truth.

description.description: Free-form description. Implementations may render as Markdown but the protocol treats it as plain text.

status.description: Materialized from the latest status_changed event. New tasks start as 'todo'.

assignee_id.description: Reference to an actor (human or agent). NULL means unassigned.

claim_holder_id.description: Actor currently holding the server-owned claim lease. NULL means unclaimed.

claim_expires_at.description: When the active claim lease expires. NULL means no active claim lease.

parent_task_id.description: UUID of the parent task. NULL means root task. Max hierarchy depth is 3 levels (enforced by implementations). Setting parent is a structural operation; children must all be done before a parent can be marked done.

created_by.description: Actor who created the task. Set on task.create, never mutates.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token. Increments on every mutation. Mutating verbs require if_match=<version> and return 409 Conflict on mismatch with the server's current task body.
